title: Dental Clinic Management System
shortDescription: Comprehensive clinic management system for patient records, appointments and billing.
fullDescription: Complete solution for dental practices featuring patient management, appointment scheduling, treatment tracking and billing. Built with Java (JSP/Servlets) for backend logic, MySQL for database management and Bootstrap for a responsive frontend. Includes modules for inventory management and reporting.

title: iNoteBook
shortDescription: Cloud-based note-taking app with CRUD operations and JWT authentication.
fullDescription: Full-stack note-taking application with user authentication (JWT), CRUD operations and cloud synchronisation. MERN stack application with a responsive design and search functionality.

title: Expense Tracker
shortDescription: Personal finance management app with analytics and budget tracking.
fullDescription: Full-featured expense tracking application with budgeting tools, spending analytics and financial reporting. MERN stack with JWT authentication.

title: React News App
shortDescription: Real-time news aggregator with category filtering using NewsAPI.
fullDescription: News application fetching articles from multiple sources using NewsAPI. Features category filtering, search and infinite scroll.

title: Text Converter
shortDescription: Web tool for text transformation including case conversion and word count.
fullDescription: Lightweight React application for text manipulation — uppercase/lowercase conversion, word count, copy to clipboard and real-time preview.

title: ShortenURL App
shortDescription: URL shortening service with analytics and QR code generation.
fullDescription: URL shortening solution that converts long URLs into short links. Features custom alias creation, click analytics and QR code generation.

title: Memes Website
shortDescription: Meme generator and sharing platform with Firebase backend.
fullDescription: Interactive meme generator with user accounts, upvoting and sharing. Built with React and Firebase.
